Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1403
Claimant:
Courtney Webb
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
6-29-25
Claim opened after the insured reported a low-speed collision in a shopping center parking lot. The claimant, the
other vehicle's driver, has retained counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
9-21-25
Reviewed the first notice of loss and confirmed the driver is named on the policy. Coverage appears to be in force for
the vehicle involved and the reported circumstances.
9-22-25
Obtained the initial photographs from the insured and the claimant's side. The visible damage is mostly in line with the
impact described by both parties.
10-3-25
Two witnesses who were in the lot have given statements. Both confirm the collision happened in the manner
described, with the vehicles backing into one another while maneuvering out of parking spaces.
10-14-25
Claimant's counsel submitted a demand package including initial treatment records reporting a back strain. The
reported injury is plausible for a collision of this type, though the records do not yet describe the claimant's seating
position at impact.
10-21-25
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Requested updated records and an itemized
list of visits to understand the course of care.
11-3-25
Medical history provided shows no prior injury to the same area of the back. No earlier claims involving this body
region have been identified in the index search.
12-5-25
Spoke with the claimant's counsel about the seating position. It is not fully clear from the current file where in the
vehicle the claimant was sitting, and the answer may matter for evaluating the injury mechanism.
1-9-26
Claimant later supplied a few additional details about the moments before impact. These are minor, and the core
account has stayed the same since the first statement.
2-12-26
Inspection noted a few old scratches on the claimant's vehicle that may predate this incident. A neighbor has also
mnetioned seeing earlier damage a few weeks before the claimed date, and this is being followed up before any
valuation is finalized.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
